integrity: Full proof, independently enumerated finite cases, exact trace classification and enumerator supplied. Self-review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected complete graphs, all Hamiltonian tours only; no claim for general host graphs, paths, nonspanning cycles, or directed tours. Historical-priority comparisons are limited to accessible sources; independent review absent.
title: Exact shattered-edge supports of Hamiltonian tours in complete graphs
